items.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
items.title_zh: 哈萨比斯转任DeepMind董事长，杰夫·迪恩离开谷歌
items.title_en: Hassabis becomes DeepMind chair as Jeff Dean exits Google
items.summary: Demis Hassabis becomes Chair, while Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat leave Google to launch a public benefit corporation, marking a major shift in Google DeepMind's leadership.

items.title: ChainDrop 蠕虫攻陷 npm 逾 1300 个包
items.title_zh: ChainDrop 蠕虫攻陷超 1300 个 npm 包
items.title_en: ChainDrop Worm Compromises Over 1,300 npm Packages
items.summary: The ChainDrop worm has infected over 1300 npm packages, including popular caching libraries, with malicious payloads that steal credentials and spread via maintenance account compromises.

items.title: Discovery Loop
items.title_zh: 杰夫·迪恩等人创立Discovery Loop以自动化AI研究
items.title_en: Jeff Dean and Colleagues Launch Discovery Loop to Automate AI Research
items.summary: Discovery Loop is an initiative to automate the experimental loop for ML research and engineering, broadly applicable across science and engineering fields.

items.title: Meta Ran Ads That Contained AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
items.title_zh: Meta投放含AI生成的儿童性虐待图像广告
items.title_en: Meta Ran Ads Containing AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
items.summary: Meta ran ads containing AI-generated child sexual abuse imagery, highlighting critical gaps in content moderation and AI safety practices.

items.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
items.title_zh: Cloudflare OS：面向智能体、应用与工作的开放平台
items.title_en: Cloudflare OS: An Open Platform for Agents, Apps, and Work
items.summary: Cloudflare introduces Cloudflare OS, an open platform for agents, apps, and work, sparking community debate about its scope, naming, and lock-in concerns.

items.title: New release of LLM adds support for reasoning traces, OpenAI Responses, server-side tools, and smarter logging
items.title_zh: LLM 0.32 新增推理轨迹、服务端工具及 OpenAI Responses API 支持
items.title_en: LLM 0.32 adds reasoning traces, server-side tools, and OpenAI Responses API support
items.summary: LLM 0.32 is a major release adding visible reasoning traces, server-side provider tools, OpenAI Responses API support, and redesigned content-addressable logging.

items.title: Running Whisper, Qwen3-ASR, Nemotron & MOSS completely offline on iPhone [P]
items.title_zh: 开源应用 LiveTranscriber 在 iPhone 上完全离线运行 Whisper、Qwen3-ASR 等模型
items.title_en: Open-Source LiveTranscriber Runs Whisper, Qwen3-ASR, Nemotron, MOSS Offline on iPhone
items.summary: An open-source iOS app (LiveTranscriber) runs Whisper, Qwen3-ASR, Nemotron, MOSS, and Qwen3 fully offline for transcription, translation, and summarization.

items.title: Monodratic: learned product-hash routing for sparse causal attention [R]
items.title_zh: Monodratic：用于稀疏因果注意力的学习乘积哈希路由
items.title_en: Monodratic: Learned Product-Hash Routing for Sparse Causal Attention
items.summary: Introduces Monodratic, a sparse causal-attention architecture using learned product-hash routing to select remote source blocks, achieving high associative-recall accuracy with a bounded attention budget.

items.title: 🤖 马斯克宣布 SpaceX 将独家采用英伟达 AI 架构
items.title_zh: 马斯克宣布 SpaceX 将独家采用英伟达 AI 架构
items.title_en: Musk Commits SpaceX Exclusively to Nvidia AI Architecture
items.summary: Elon Musk announced SpaceX will exclusively use Nvidia's AI architecture, deploying Vera Rubin systems in ground and space data centers including the Starmind satellite project.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek 重启第二轮融资 投前估值 5000 亿元
items.title_zh: DeepSeek重启第二轮融资 投前估值5000亿元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Restarts Second Funding Round at ¥500B Pre-Money Valuation
items.summary: DeepSeek has restarted its second round of financing with a pre-money valuation of 500 billion yuan, planning to raise 50 billion yuan.

items.title: 三星与 SK 海力士据报测试中微设备 对冲美国出口管制风险
items.title_zh: 三星与SK海力士据报测试中国芯片设备 对冲美国出口管制风险
items.title_en: Samsung, SK Hynix Test Chinese Chip Tools to Hedge US Export Curb Risks
items.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix are reportedly testing Chinese chip equipment maker AMEC's etching tools for their China factories to mitigate risks from US export controls, though no large-scale deployment has been decided yet.
